Chandigarh Police Constable 2027 - Pattern & Eligibility

≈ 2 min to finish · Beginner

I cleared the Punjab Police Sub Inspector exam with Rank 2 (713/800). Chandigarh Police is a Union Territory force, so its recruitment runs separately from Punjab Police - different notice, different portal, different paper.

The last round was the Chandigarh Police notice of 20 May 2023 for 700 Constable (Executive) posts, plus a separate sports-quota list. Selection had a written test, physical test, document check and medical. No 2027 notification has been released yet.

Will there be posts in 2027?

Our archive has papers from 2013, 2018 and 2023 - roughly one big round every few years. On that pattern a 2027 round is possible but not certain. Keep your 10+2 marks sheet, category certificate and fitness ready, because Chandigarh windows are short.

Eligibility (2023 notice)

  • Education: 10+2 from a recognised board.
  • Age: reported as 18 to 25 years (as on 20 May 2023), with relaxation for reserved categories.
  • Physical standards and test: height, chest and running standards apply - read them in the notice.
  • Fee (2023): reported as Rs 1,000 for general/OBC, Rs 800 for SC and EWS, and nil for ex-servicemen.

Selection process

StageWhat
Written testObjective MCQ - reported as 100 marks, 1 mark each, 1/4 cut for a wrong answer
Physical testRunning and physical measurement
Documents and medicalFinal checks

How to prepare

  1. Solve all three papers: Chandigarh Police Constable 2013, 2018 and 2023.
  2. GK of Chandigarh and India - the UT's administration, landmarks and history come up.
  3. Reasoning and maths at 10+2 level.
  4. English and computer basics.
  5. Start running now - the physical test is where many written-test toppers fall.

Straight answers

Frequently asked questions

When was the last Chandigarh Police Constable recruitment?

Chandigarh Police released a notice on 20 May 2023 for 700 Constable (Executive) posts, with a separate sports-quota list.

What is the eligibility for Chandigarh Police Constable?

10+2 from a recognised board. The 2023 notice was reported with an age range of 18 to 25 years, plus relaxation for reserved categories. Physical standards apply.

What is the exam pattern?

An objective written test, reported as 100 marks with 1 mark per question and 1/4 mark cut for a wrong answer, followed by a physical test, document verification and a medical. Confirm the exact pattern in the next notice.

Which papers are available for practice?

Our archive has the Chandigarh Police Constable papers of 2013, 2018 (16 November) and 2023 (Set C).

Will Chandigarh Police recruit constables in 2027?

Rounds have come every few years - our papers are from 2013, 2018 and 2023. A 2027 round is possible but not confirmed. No 2027 notification has been released yet.
